figurative_meaning_en: Ability to distinguish between good and bad
similar_in_english: Separate the wheat from the chaff
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কাক-কোকিলে ভেদ নেই, সবকিছুতে সে ভুল করে।
এই ছেলেটির কাক-কোকিলে ভেদ আছে, তাই সে সঠিক সিদ্ধান্ত নেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He has no distinction between crow and cuckoo, so he always makes wrong choices.
This boy can distinguish between crow and cuckoo, so he makes the right decisions.
note: The idiom draws from rural imagery of birds that may appear similar but have distinct qualities, symbolizing subtle moral differences.
